blocks.text: MANILA – Tropical Storm Queenie slightly intensified Friday, with maximum sustained winds of 85 kilometers per hour (kph) and gustiness of up to 105 kph, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) said. No wind signal is hoisted on any part of the country, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) said. Queenie was last tracked 745 km east of Basco, Batanes. It is moving west northwestward at 20 kph.
